create_mobilenet_model: create a MobileNet model with a configurable number of output classes for image classification
build_mobilenet_block: build a depthwise separable convolution Block with configurable input planes, output planes, and stride
run_mobilenet_forward: run a forward pass through the MobileNet model on a batch of 3-channel 32x32 images
test_mobilenet_inference: test the MobileNet model by passing a random 32x32 image and printing the output tensor size
review_mobilenet_cfg: review the MobileNet configuration list that defines channel depths and stride values for each Block layer
